identity: Green-blue midrange built on Vesuvan Duplimancy. Duplimancy copies the PERMANENT, not the spell: 'Whenever you cast a spell that targets only a single artifact or creature you control, create a token that's a copy of that artifact or creature.' So a one-mana instant aimed at your own 6/6 buys a second 6/6. Eight of the twenty-three nonland cards satisfy that clause, which is why this build fields the largest legal bodies in the colours rather than the cheapest: the engine converts mana into whichever creature is already best on board. Ivy, Gleeful Spellthief is a complementary second engine — a trick aimed at a non-Ivy creature you control fires Duplimancy AND copies the spell onto Ivy.

restrictions.deck_construction_constraint: max 5 rare/mythic total across mainboard + sideboard

mainboard.name: Vesuvan Duplimancy
mainboard.oracle_text: Whenever you cast a spell that targets only a single artifact or creature you control, create a token that's a copy of that artifact or creature, except it's not legendary.
mainboard.role: Payoff — the copy engine; a cheap spell aimed at your own body mints a token copy of that body

mainboard.name: Ivy, Gleeful Spellthief
mainboard.oracle_text:
Flying
Whenever a player casts a spell that targets only a single creature other than Ivy, you may copy that spell. The copy targets Ivy. (A copy of an Aura spell becomes a token.)
mainboard.role: Payoff — second engine; the same trick that fires Duplimancy also copies the spell onto Ivy

mainboard.name: Defiler of Vigor
mainboard.oracle_text:
Trample
As an additional cost to cast green permanent spells, you may pay 2 life. Those spells cost {G} less to cast if you paid life this way. This effect reduces only the amount of green mana you pay.
Whenever you cast a green permanent spell, put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
mainboard.role: Threat — 6/6 trample; discounts green permanents by {G} for 2 life and puts a +1/+1 counter on every creature, tokens included

mainboard.name: Llanowar Greenwidow
mainboard.oracle_text:
Reach, trample
Domain — {7}{G}: Return this card from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped. It gains "If this permanent would leave the battlefield, exile it instead of putting it anywhere else." This ability costs {1} less to activate for each basic land type among lands you control.
mainboard.role: Threat — 4/3 reach trample for three, the best mana-to-stats copy target in the pool

mainboard.name: Frostfist Strider
mainboard.oracle_text:
Ward {2} (Whenever this creature becomes the target of a spell or ability an opponent controls, counter it unless that player pays {2}.)
When this creature enters, tap target creature an opponent controls and put a stun counter on it. (If a permanent with a stun counter would become untapped, remove one from it instead.)
mainboard.role: Threat — 4/4 ward {2}; its ETB taps and stuns a blocker, and each token copy taps another

mainboard.name: Micromancer
mainboard.oracle_text: When this creature enters, you may search your library for an instant or sorcery card with mana value 1, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
mainboard.role: Threat — 3/3 whose ETB tutors a mana-value-1 instant, i.e. it finds another engine trigger

mainboard.name: Elvish Hydromancer
mainboard.oracle_text:
Kicker {3}{U} (You may pay an additional {3}{U} as you cast this spell.)
When this creature enters, if it was kicked, create a token that's a copy of target creature you control.
mainboard.role: Threat — 3/2; kicked at six mana it clones your best body, the deck's only redundancy for a 1-of mythic engine

mainboard.name: Combat Research
mainboard.oracle_text:
Enchant creature
Enchanted creature has "Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, draw a card."
As long as enchanted creature is legendary, it gets +1/+1 and has ward {1}. (Whenever enchanted creature becomes the target of a spell or ability an opponent controls, counter it unless that player pays {1}.)
mainboard.role: Enabler — an AURA targets on cast, so it fires Duplimancy for a token copy of the enchanted body; the copy also lands on Ivy as a token Aura, and it is the deck's only repeating card draw

mainboard.name: Shore Up
mainboard.oracle_text: Target creature you control gets +1/+1 and gains hexproof until end of turn. Untap it. (It can't be the target of spells or abilities your opponents control.)
mainboard.role: Enabler — {U} targets a single creature you control: fires both engines AND protects the target from removal in response

mainboard.name: Strength of the Coalition
mainboard.oracle_text:
Kicker {2}{W} (You may pay an additional {2}{W} as you cast this spell.)
Target creature you control gets +2/+2 until end of turn. If this spell was kicked, put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
mainboard.role: Enabler — {G} 'Target creature you control gets +2/+2'; one mana, no Domain or colour dependency

mainboard.name: Gaea's Might
mainboard.oracle_text: Domain — Target creature gets +1/+1 until end of turn for each basic land type among lands you control.
mainboard.role: Enabler — {G} Domain pump on a single creature

mainboard.name: Deathbloom Gardener
mainboard.oracle_text:
Deathtouch
{T}: Add one mana of any color.
mainboard.role: Infrastructure — '{T}: Add one mana of any color' is FREE acceleration (unlike Salvaged Manaworker, which taxes {1} to produce 1), and deathtouch makes it a real blocker

mainboard.name: Llanowar Loamspeaker
mainboard.oracle_text:
{T}: Add one mana of any color.
{T}: Target land you control becomes a 3/3 Elemental creature with haste until end of turn. It's still a land. Activate only as a sorcery.
mainboard.role: Infrastructure — two-mana '{T}: Add one mana of any color'; turn-2 into turn-3 Duplimancy

mainboard.name: Bite Down
mainboard.oracle_text: Target creature you control deals damage equal to its power to target creature or planeswalker you don't control.
mainboard.role: Interaction — the only unconditional creature removal in these colours; scales with the oversized bodies this deck fields

mainboard.name: Essence Scatter
mainboard.oracle_text: Counter target creature spell.
mainboard.role: Interaction — buys the turn needed to untap with a four-mana enchantment

mainboard.name: Negate
mainboard.oracle_text: Counter target noncreature spell.
mainboard.role: Interaction — the ONLY card in the list that can protect Vesuvan Duplimancy, and it answers all 6 of the cube's sweepers (none is a creature spell)

mainboard.name: Broken Wings
mainboard.oracle_text: Destroy target artifact, enchantment, or creature with flying.
mainboard.role: Interaction — destroy target artifact, enchantment, or creature with flying

mainboard.name: Forest
mainboard.role: Land — G source and the Forest basic type

mainboard.name: Island
mainboard.role: Land — U source and the Island basic type

mainboard.name: Wooded Ridgeline
mainboard.oracle_text:
({T}: Add {R} or {G}.)
This land enters tapped.
mainboard.role: Land — Mountain Forest: a GREEN source carrying a THIRD basic land type for Domain; enters tapped

mainboard.name: Tangled Islet
mainboard.oracle_text:
({T}: Add {G} or {U}.)
This land enters tapped.
mainboard.role: Land — the only GU dual carrying BOTH the Forest and Island types; enters tapped

mainboard.name: Crystal Grotto
mainboard.oracle_text:
When this land enters, scry 1.
{T}: Add {C}.
{1}, {T}: Add one mana of any color.
mainboard.role: Land — untapped, scry 1 on entry, and '{1},{T}: Add one mana of any color' for the double pips

sideboard.name: Snarespinner
sideboard.oracle_text:
Reach
Whenever this creature blocks a creature with flying, this creature gets +2/+0 until end of turn.
sideboard.role: vs evasion (51 cards, 20.7% of the cube) — reach, and +2/+0 whenever it blocks a flier

sideboard.name: Tear Asunder
sideboard.oracle_text:
Kicker {1}{B} (You may pay an additional {1}{B} as you cast this spell.)
Exile target artifact or enchantment. If this spell was kicked, exile target nonland permanent instead.
sideboard.role: vs noncreature permanents (15 artifacts, 18 enchantments) — exile target artifact or enchantment; the base mode needs no black

sideboard.name: Impede Momentum
sideboard.oracle_text:
Tap target creature and put three stun counters on it. (If a permanent with a stun counter would become untapped, remove one from it instead.)
Scry 1. (Look at the top card of your library. You may put that card on the bottom.)
sideboard.role: vs a single resolved large creature — tap it and put three stun counters on it, which neutralises it for three untaps; replaces two slots that answered no class in the threat profile

sideboard.name: Broken Wings
sideboard.oracle_text: Destroy target artifact, enchantment, or creature with flying.
sideboard.role: vs artifacts, enchantments and fliers — second copy

sideboard.name: Bite Down
sideboard.oracle_text: Target creature you control deals damage equal to its power to target creature or planeswalker you don't control.
sideboard.role: vs creature decks — second copy of the deck's only unconditional creature removal

sideboard.name: Essence Scatter
sideboard.role: vs decks whose plan is one large creature — second copy

sideboard.name: Impulse
sideboard.oracle_text: Look at the top four cards of your library. Put one of them into your hand and the rest on the bottom of your library in any order.
sideboard.role: vs slower decks — digs four deep for Vesuvan Duplimancy, which is 1 of 40
